_comment: FRC Vision Pipeline Config — Update this file for each new game season.

game._comment_target_classes: List of class names your trained model uses for the current game piece. Case-insensitive.
game._comment_known_diameter: Approximate largest dimension of the game piece in inches (used for distance estimation).
game._comment_aspect_ratio: Bounding-box aspect ratio (w/h) limits. Detections outside [min, max] are discarded as false positives.

field._comment: 2026 Reefscape field dimensions in meters for out-of-bounds sanity checks.
